chat.t: I have come to share the good word.

o: What's this text message?

chat.t:
Harmonix is
always watching over you.

o: What, is this a stalker?

chat.t: Harmonix forgives you.

o: Who said anyone could forgive me?
This is starting to get annoying.

chat.t: She even loves your annoyance.

o: No, seriously, who are you to be this persistent?

chat.t: {player}, you need us.

o: So, who are you?

chat.t: This is 'Feelharmony'.

o: Huh?
Feelharmony Monastery?

chat.t: Do you know us?

o: I've heard a lot of rumors about Sister 101.
I heard the competition to become a sister there is extremely fierce.

chat.t: ...Pardon?
I do not know where you heard such things, but rumors are merely rumors.

o: Huh? Really?
Well, whatever.
I'll find out when I see it in person.
When and where should we meet?

chat.t: Repentrepentrepentrepentrepentrepent

o: I can't hear you, I can't see you.

chat.t: Repentrepentrepentrepentrepentrepent

o: This is just spam.
I don't care about repenting, but if you want to hang out, I'm down.

chat.t: ...Next time, I will make sure to save you.

o: Go ahead and try.

lines.t: In front of the Feelharmony Monastery
So, where is the sister who invited me?
She must be an incredibly gorgeous, idol-level sister.
Who are you looking for? Why are you here? Are you a new believer??
Whoa, you startled me!

Why are you startled?
I was merely asking a few questions...

I mean, you're not bad, but... hmm...
Your face is just... kind of forgettable...
...Excuse me?

It's alright, Sister.
He is my guest.
Ah! Abbess.

Thank you.
I will guide him from here.
I am glad you found your way here.

Allow me to introduce myself formally.
Welcome to Feelharmony Monastery!
So, you're the one who kept spamming me on MochiTalk?
Yes. Allow me to introduce myself first.

I am Ines.
Though I am lacking, I serve as the Abbess of this monastery.
...I guess the rumors weren't wrong.
Pardon?
The rumor about 'Feelharmony, the idols of Harmonix'.
They say ordinary looks won't get you through that insanely fierce competition.
It's a real shame I couldn't see Sister 101 in person...
...Haa.
Suddenly, Ines began to pray right in front of me.

Forgive this lamb who harbors wicked and impure thoughts.
Since his heart is not pure...
What are you doing all of a sudden...
This pitiful lamb has come here to confess his sins and be reborn...
Excuse me? Hello?
You're pretending not to hear me on purpose, aren't you?
I was offering a brief prayer for you, a pitiful soul.
Pitiful? Me?
I have heard that you have committed far too many sins.

Public indecency. Theft. Prison break. Sexual harassment, and so on...
If only you had known 'Feelharmony' instead of wasting your time on such things...
By now, you would have become a VIP follower of 'Harmonix'.
Are there any perks for being a VIP?

Repent.
We will help you in accordance with the will of Harmonix.
What? Are you planning to overwhelm me with numbers?
If we all unite to pray for you, Harmonix will surely forgive your sins as well.
Now, please repent of your sins and let us pray together.
I really just came here to see idols.

...Sisters?
Quickly, grab him.

This is ridiculous.
Go ahead and try to catch me if you can.

The game of hide-and-seek with the sisters,
whose stamina rivaled that of idols, finally ended at dusk.

Gasp! Gasp! You guys are seriously persistent!
Just give up already.

No. I cannot give up.
To abandon a lamb would make me unfit to be a sister.

When dedication goes that far, it's an obsession.
It's a sickness.
This is not an obsession. It is salvation.
I will help you so that you can never harbor impure thoughts again!
Ah, so the impure thoughts are the problem?
But looking at you, it'd be more of a problem if I DIDN'T have impure thoughts.
W-What did you say??

What's with that reaction?
That was a compliment.
You're the Abbess because you're the best out of all those idols, aren't you?
Forgivethislambwhoharborswickedandimpurethoughtssincehisheartisnotpure...
Wow, they said you were an idol, and you can even rap.

chat.t: There is a problem.

o: What are you talking about all of a sudden?

chat.t: There is a problem.

o: Is this some new seduction technique?

chat.t: ...The problem needs to be resolved.
To resolve this problem, you must come to the monastery immediately.
It is an extremely urgent matter.

o: I don't want to go... No matter how I look at it, it's definitely a trap.

chat.t: The problem needs to be resolved. Please come to the monastery.
I will keep sending this until you arrive.

The problem needs to be resolved. Please come to the monastery.
The problem needs to be resolved. Please come to the monastery.

The problem needs to be resolved. Please come to the monastery.
The problem needs to be resolved. Please come to the monastery.

The problem needs to be resolved. Please come to the monastery.
The problem needs to be resolved. Please come to the monastery.

o: Stop sending them!!! You obsessive sister!!

chat.t: It is not an obsession.

o: Sigh, fine, whatever.

lines.t: Inside the Feelharmony Monastery
Yo, I'm here.
<bouten>Problem</bouten>.

What are you talking about?
You said there was a request.
The <bouten>problem</bouten> has arrived.
This is a huge <bouten>problem</bouten> that only you can solve.
No, I mean, what IS it?
It is you.
...I knew it would turn out like this.

An idol must be clever, after all.
That was a good trap.

I am not an idol...
And deceiving you? That is absurd.

You rejected our help, and did not repent to Harmonix, did you?
Therefore, you are a problem.

This is ridiculous.
Anyway, I'm a busy man. Is it really okay to treat me like this?
There is nowhere to run.
I will not let you escape today!
So that's how it's gonna be?

Gasp... Gasp... Pl-Please stop...!
How are you so good at running away...!
Heh... If there's one thing I learned from my trio of idiots at home... it's this!
Just give up... I have absolutely no intention of letting you catch me.
The long chase finally ended only when evening arrived.
Sigh... Why do you reject salvation so stubbornly...
Look, like I said, at that point, it's just an obsession.
It is not.
Yes, it is.

After letting out a brief sigh, Ines straightened her clothes
and looked straight at me.
Harmonix fairly grants everyone an opportunity for a fresh start.
Even a sinner like you deserves to receive this gift and make a fresh start.
No, I'm really not interested, okay?
It doesn't even sound like a very appealing gift.
Still, wouldn't you at least listen to our story just once?
I promise I won't force you to join.
Hmm, let me think...
Even when I ask you like this?
Hmm...
Hmmmm...
Nope.

chat.t: Hello. {player}
Do you have a moment to talk?

o: Are you trying to set another trap?

chat.t: A trap? I would never do such a thing.
Actually, there is an outdoor gathering today.
I really want to share the words of Harmonix with you, {player}.
If you have time, please come to the monastery.
I will not mind what you think of it afterwards.
I will be waiting.

o: Hey, wait.
She's only saying what she wants to say again.

chat.t: Are you alright?
About what happened today... No, it is nothing.
Please get some rest.

o: I actually liked it.

chat.t: Haa...

lines.t:
It wasn't because of Ines's MochiTalk,
but since I was free anyway, I headed to the monastery.

By the way, what exactly are these teachings
that Ines and the others take so seriously?
Maybe I'm slightly interested.
Inside the Feelharmony Monastery
Must be nice for this Harmonix person, having so many people believe in them.
While some of us are struggling to even pay rent and have to look for work every day.
Harmonix said, embrace your neighbors with all your heart.
Here in this very place, an unforgiven, pitiful lamb has arrived.
Now! Let us all welcome our new prospective believer as he steps up to the platform.
(Sigh, I knew this would happen.)

You have been given a chance to repent.
Please step up here.
Everyone's eyes focused on me.
I walk up to the platform.
And say a word to Ines.
Thank you for coming.
I knew it was a trap.

A trap?
You came here of your own free will.
I can't deny that, but it's still annoying.
Anyway, you're definitely the prettiest among all the members here.
As expected of the number one idol, the Abbess!

E-Everyone!
From now on, I will enter the specially prepared Confessional with this gentleman.
There, we shall offer a prayer of repentance to Harmonix together.
Please pray along with us, everyone.
Wait, a prayer?

Ignoring my words, Ines grabbed my hand
and began dragging me toward the Confessional in front of us.
Since there wasn't much reason to resist, I just followed along...
(Her tail is suddenly reaching toward me?)
(What's going on? Why does it feel like it keeps targeting me?)
Completely exhausted, Ines and I walked out of the Confessional.
Inside the Feelharmony Monastery
{player}, are you alright?
It was huge!
Pardon?
It's an unforgettable size!
Are you speaking of such impure things again...

No, blame your tail.
I'm telling you, I didn't do anything.
By the way... did you just not wear any today? Or do you never wear them?
...Please stop.
Well, anyway, thanks to you, I got an experience far more valuable than a prayer.
If repentance is like this every day, maybe being a believer wouldn't be so bad...
I told you to stop!
What's up with your tail all of a sudden? Are you in heat?
Haa...
It is embarrassing, so I do not wish to speak of it.
But... if there is an opportunity later, I will tell you...
What happened today is partly my responsibility as well...
Is this really something you need to take responsibility for?

Anyway, a tail that moves regardless of its owner's Will.
How amusing!
This will not happen next time.
But... you will meet me again, right?

chat.t: {player}, sir?

o: What's the matter?

chat.t: Do you happen to have some time?
{player}, I feel like it has to be you...
I have something I want to tell you in person, so please come to the monastery.

o: It's probably another trap.
What's this? Why is it so quiet this time?
Usually, this is when she'd chime in to say it's not a trap.
Hello?

lines.t: I came because Ines seemed to be in worse shape than usual, but...
Well, I'm sure it's nothing.
Inside the Feelharmony Monastery
As I stepped inside the monastery, I saw Ines standing there, dazed.
Well, look at you, waiting to greet me.
So, what's this worry you need me to listen to?
Excuse me?

Welcome!
I was just feeling lonely, how perfect...
Whoa, you're acting way different than usual.
Mmm... is that so?
Then why don't you tell me what "usual" is like?
Your tone is weird too.

The vibe is much more suggestive than usual...
Well, I mean, your body was always like that, but still.

...What?!
My body is w-what, what did you say?!!
W-What are you saying all of a sudden?!
You're back, Ines!

...?
I have been here the whole time.
...So you aren't even aware.
What on earth are you talking about?
Well, if you have nothing else to say, I'm leaving.
...Wait a moment!
Excuse me... Did I seem strangely different from usual?
You were completely bizarre.
Suddenly dropping honorifics and talking nonsense.
Oh...
In the end... I wanted to hide it until the very end... but I have no choice.
Just for a moment... I believe I was overcome by my inner drive.
Drive?
Yes. As you can see, I am a sister, but I am also a succubus.

So what?
Is that just a trait of the succubus race?

Yes... that is the case.
However, I am a faithful servant who believes in Harmonix.
I have endured my instinctual drive through my faith in Harmonix and sheer willpower.
Up until now, there were no issues... but my condition has suddenly deteriorated recently...
Ever since I first met {player}, I believe something has changed.
So you're saying it's my fault?

O-Oh, no!
This is entirely my own issue...

But...
I feared I might cause trouble for {player} again, so I wanted to seek your counsel.

So, after agonizing over it, I sent {player} a MochiTalk message...
but I have no memory of what happened after that.
Even your tail acting up last time?

Yes...
I believe I did that unconsciously.
I actually like it. Do it again next time.
H-How sacrilegious!
C-Come to think of it, I believe this is all {player}'s fault!!

{player}, if you had listened to me and repented properly...
my heart would not have been so shaken...
Unbelievable.
You just said it wasn't my fault.
...Sigh. I am sorry.

My condition is still not very good...
I am having trouble controlling my emotions.
I have made up my mind.
I shall confess my sins and {player}'s to Harmonix.
Why me too?
If we pray together, Harmonix will surely forgive us.
Then, my mind will be at ease again...
What if I say no?
I understand. In that case, {player}, you may head back first.
I will offer prayers on {player}'s behalf as well.
Suit yourself. I'm leaving, then.
...Heh. Until next time...

It looked as though Ines's tail was starting to coil
and wrap around her own thigh...
Well, I'm sure she'll manage.

chat.t: {player}, sir?
I would like to make you an offer you cannot refuse.

o: What is it?

chat.t: If you join me in one final prayer to Harmonix, I will not bother you anymore.

o: I just have to pray?

chat.t: A sister does not tell lies.

o: Then what was with all those traps up until now?

chat.t: Those were not traps.

o: Okay, she seems like the usual Ines.
You're not trying to do anything weird, right?

chat.t: Of course not.

o: Like in an adult manga?

chat.t: ...Excuse me?
{player}, sir. I have not been able to greet you properly.
Thank you so much for today.

o: Show a little more gratitude.

chat.t: Having experienced this again, I simply cannot give up on converting {player}.

o: How many times do I have to tell you that obsession is an illness?

chat.t: It is not obsession, it is concern.

o: Too much concern is exactly what obsession is!

chat.t: At any rate, I shall pray for {player}'s happiness.
Please show your face from time to time, my prospective believer.

o: She really only hears what she wants to hear!
Well, I'll think about it.

lines.t: Inside the Feelharmony Monastery
You have arrived.
This really is the last time, right?
Yes! This is the last time.
This isn't like, the last of the last of the last times, is it?

No, it is not.
Now, please come forward.

In the quiet, solemn atmosphere of the empty monastery,
Ines began to speak softly.
My body and soul have already been dedicated to Harmonix.
But...
Before Harmonix... I have become a sinner, rather than a devout servant.
{player}is on my mind; I have come to like {player}, and eventually, to desire {player}—I have become a sinner.
Ines? Hey?! Your tail is doing it again...
My drive has been awakened because of you...
I want to unleash this heart that I've suppressed all this time to my heart's content...
...This is a bit sudden, but there's no way out.
...Heh. I will absolutely not let you go this time.
...Fine, go ahead and try.
Good! Then you've agreed too, right? Heh heh heh...
Inside the Feelharmony Monastery
Hey. Are you back to your senses?
{player}, did I change again?
Just how much do you suppress your drive on a daily basis?
I seriously thought my soul was going to be squeezed dry.

W-What are you saying?
What on earth happened...

Never mind that...
Don't you find it frustrating?
How can you even enjoy life like that?
I consider it a trial that Harmonix has bestowed upon me.

You're so stiff.
Let's be honest for once.

Anyway...
since you called me here to pray, let's do it.
With what face can I pray, having become a sinner once more...
The prayers for your drives that Harmonix won't accept...
I'll accept them instead.
By what authority do you...

Never mind that. Ines.
What is your worry?
...Haa.
As a sister who must hold devout faith, I fear that I will be unable to control my drive.
Any other worries?
I also heard rumors from the other sisters behind my back, saying that I am secretly doing suspicious things.
Is this situation hard on you?
I worry whether I can fulfill my duties and mission as a sister without wavering.
Then express it.

There is no way I could ever express this...
It is embarrassing, ugly, and filled only with sin...

Why not?
Who in the world lives without a single drive?
Keeping it all bottled up like that is what's making you sick.

...Sigh.
My thoughts are becoming complicated...

Just live a bit more honestly.
Then you'll feel better.

Anyway, the prayer is over.
I'm heading out, okay?
Um...
What is it now?
Could you perhaps visit me, even if not often, just once in a while?
Well... as long as Ines doesn't go into heat and pounce on me again?

...I am not in heat.
That is impure.

Just kidding.
See ya.
